title: abandonment — adopt

sentences.sentence: ...memories of her father's complete abandonment of her.
sentences.translation: …她父亲对她的彻底抛弃的那些记忆。

sentences.sentence: Both were big at birth but were not abnormally large.
sentences.translation: 这两个孩子出生时都比较大，但并非异常的大。

sentences.sentence: This way, if the function or procedure crashes or terminates abnormally, it will not affect any of the other instance processes.
sentences.translation: 这样，如果该函数或过程崩溃或者异常终止，也不会对其他实例进程产生任何影响。

sentences.sentence: People with the condition have red blood cells smaller than normal — causing a mild form of anaemia — but abnormally high levels of them.
sentences.translation: 患有这种病的人的红细胞比正常人的更小——这导致了一种轻微的贫血——但是红细胞水平异常地高。

sentences.sentence: ‘Do you let your kids travel alone at night?’ ‘Absolutely not!’
sentences.translation: “你会让孩子们晚上单独外出吗？”“当然不行！”

phrases.translation: [计]抽象类（不允许实例化的类）
抽象思维；抽象思考能力

sentences.sentence: By the age of seven, children are capable of thinking in abstract terms .
sentences.translation: 儿童到了七岁就具有抽象思维的能力。

sentences.sentence: Human beings are the only creatures capable of abstract thought (=  thinking about ideas  ) .
sentences.translation: 人类是唯一具有抽象思维能力的动物。

言语虐待；口头谩骂；说粗话，用污言秽语

sentences.translation: 数宗虐待儿童案

sentences.sentence: An independent committee will look into alleged human rights abuses.
sentences.translation: 一个独立委员会将对涉嫌践踏人权的行为进行调查。

sentences.sentence: measures to accelerate the rate of economic growth
sentences.translation: 加快经济增长速度的措施

sentences.sentence: We have accomplished all we set out to do.
sentences.translation: 所有计划要做的事情，我们都已完成。

sentences.sentence: (=  we have done what we intended to do  ) .
sentences.translation: 大功告成。

phrases.translation: 总会计师；会计主任，会计处长
注册会计师；会计师；特许会计师

初级会计师；助理会计员

sentences.sentence: The boss dropped an accountant from the payroll.
sentences.translation: 老板把一名会计师从在职人员名单中除了名。

sentences.sentence: The accountant checked this unnecessary spending in good time.
sentences.translation: 会计及时卡住了这笔不必要的开支。

sentences.sentence: They conferred with the accountant vis-à-vis the proposed budget.
sentences.translation: 他们与会计商量有关预算提案的事。

sentences.sentence: Interest will accrue until payment is made.
sentences.translation: 利息将会累计增加，直至付清款项。

sentences.sentence: The brochure tries to give a fair and accurate description of each hotel.
sentences.translation: 该手册尽量公正、准确地介绍每一家酒店。

sentences.sentence: The professor stands accused of (=  has been accused of  ) stealing his student’s ideas and publishing them.
sentences.translation: 那位教授被指控剽窃学生的观点拿去发表。

sentences.sentence: She tried to accustom herself to the tight bandages.
sentences.translation: 她尝试着使自己习惯那些紧绷的绷带。

sentences.sentence: Frances achieved very good exam results.
sentences.translation: 弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。

sentences.sentence: Wilson has achieved considerable success as an artist.
sentences.translation: 威尔逊作为一名艺术家成就斐然。

sentences.sentence: She eventually achieved her goal of becoming a professor.
sentences.translation: 她终于实现目标，当上了教授。

phrases.translation: 相识不深的人；不完整或肤浅的知识

sentences.sentence: She was a casual acquaintance of my family in Vienna.
sentences.translation: 她是我们家在维也纳的一个交情不深的朋友。

sentences.sentence: He heard about the job through a mutual acquaintance (=  someone you and another person both know  ) .
sentences.translation: 他是通过一个双方都认识的人知道有这份工作的。

sentences.sentence: Cooking fumes may activate the alarm.
sentences.translation: 烹调时的油烟可能会触发警报器。

sentences.sentence: The yeast’s growth is activated by sugar and warmth.
sentences.translation: 糖分和温暖的环境会激发酵母菌的生长。

sentences.sentence: We continue to conduct tests, but increasingly, we conduct long conversations with her, acutely aware that our creation will raise many ethical questions on the part of the public.
sentences.translation: 我们将继续进行测试，但越来越多地，随着长时间的交谈，我们敏锐地意识到，我们的作品将在公众当中引起许多道德问题。

sentences.sentence: Meanwhile, Walt's meth-business partner, the addict Jesse, is still recovering from the drug-related death of his girlfriend Jane at the end of last season.
sentences.translation: 而沃特的制毒搭档——瘾君子杰西还未从女朋友之死的痛苦中恢复过来。 他的女朋友简在上一季结尾时死于毒品。

sentences.translation: 我们正在寻找一个有管理经验的人。

sentences.sentence: The health service spends too much on administration.
sentences.translation: 医疗服务部门在行政方面花费太多。

sentences.sentence: The courts were asked to adopt a more flexible approach to young offenders.
sentences.translation: 法庭被要求对少年犯采取更为灵活的处理方法。

sentences.sentence: The store recently adopted a drug testing policy for all new employees.
sentences.translation: 这家商店近来实行新雇员一律要做药检的政策。

sentences.sentence: California has adopted a tough stance on the issue.
sentences.translation: 加利福尼亚州对这一问题持强硬立场。

text:
英语词汇 · 六级 · 第 1 单元

abandonment
音标：英 /əˈbændənmənt/  美 /ə'bændənmənt/
n. 放弃
例句：...memories of her father's complete abandonment of her.
…她父亲对她的彻底抛弃的那些记忆。

abnormally
音标：英 /æb'nɔ:məlɪ/
adv. 不正常的
例句：Both were big at birth but were not abnormally large.
这两个孩子出生时都比较大，但并非异常的大。
例句：This way, if the function or procedure crashes or terminates abnormally, it will not affect any of the other instance processes.
这样，如果该函数或过程崩溃或者异常终止，也不会对其他实例进程产生任何影响。
例句：People with the condition have red blood cells smaller than normal — causing a mild form of anaemia — but abnormally high levels of them.
患有这种病的人的红细胞比正常人的更小——这导致了一种轻微的贫血——但是红细胞水平异常地高。

absolutely
音标：英 /ˈæbsəlu:tli/  美 /'æbsəlutli/
adv. 当然
短语：absolutely necessary — 绝对必要
例句：‘Do you let your kids travel alone at night?’ ‘Absolutely not!’
“你会让孩子们晚上单独外出吗？”“当然不行！”

abstract
音标：英 /'æbstrækt/  美 /'æbstrækt/
adj. 抽象的
短语：in the abstract — 抽象地；理论上；概括地
短语：abstract art — n. 抽象派；抽象主义
短语：abstract class — [计]抽象类（不允许实例化的类）
短语：abstract thinking — 抽象思维；抽象思考能力
短语：abstract painting — 抽象画；抽象绘画
短语：abstract noun — 抽象名词
短语：abstract factory — 抽象工厂
短语：abstract data type — [计]抽象数据类型
短语：abstract expressionism — n. 抽象表现主义
短语：abstract idea — 抽象观念
短语：abstract algebra — 抽象代数
短语：abstract away from — 对…不予考虑
例句：By the age of seven, children are capable of thinking in abstract terms .
儿童到了七岁就具有抽象思维的能力。
例句：Human beings are the only creatures capable of abstract thought (=  thinking about ideas  ) .
人类是唯一具有抽象思维能力的动物。

abuse
音标：英 /ə'bju:s/  美 /ə'bjus/
n. 虐待
v. 滥用
短语：drug abuse — 药物滥用；毒品滥用
短语：child abuse — 虐待儿童，摧残儿童
短语：substance abuse — 物质滥用；滥用药物
短语：sexual abuse — 性虐待
短语：abuse of power — 滥用权力
短语：alcohol abuse — 酒精滥用，酗酒
短语：physical abuse — 躯体虐待；身体伤害；外观损坏
短语：verbal abuse — 言语虐待；口头谩骂；说粗话，用污言秽语
短语：sex abuse — 性虐待（等于sexual abuse）
短语：emotional abuse — 精神虐待
例句：several cases of child abuse
数宗虐待儿童案
例句：An independent committee will look into alleged human rights abuses.
一个独立委员会将对涉嫌践踏人权的行为进行调查。

accelerate
音标：英 /ək'seləreɪt/  美 /əkˈsɛləˌret/
v. 加速
例句：measures to accelerate the rate of economic growth
加快经济增长速度的措施

accomplish
音标：英 /ə'kʌmplɪʃ/  美 /ə'kɑmplɪʃ/
v. 实现
短语：accomplish nothing — 一事无成；一无所成
例句：We have accomplished all we set out to do.
所有计划要做的事情，我们都已完成。
例句：(=  we have done what we intended to do  ) .
大功告成。

accountant
音标：英 /əˈkaʊntənt/  美 /ə'kaʊntənt/
n. 会计
短语：certified public accountant — 有合格证件的会计师
短语：public accountant — 公共会计师
短语：chief accountant — 总会计师；会计主任，会计处长
短语：chartered accountant — 注册会计师；会计师；特许会计师
短语：professional accountant — 专业会计师
短语：certified accountant — 注册会计师；审定会计师
短语：tax accountant — 税务会计；税务师
短语：assistant accountant — 助理会计
短语：senior accountant — 高级会计；主任会计师
短语：junior accountant — 初级会计师；助理会计员
短语：qualified accountant — 合格的会计师
例句：The boss dropped an accountant from the payroll.
老板把一名会计师从在职人员名单中除了名。
例句：The accountant checked this unnecessary spending in good time.
会计及时卡住了这笔不必要的开支。
例句：They conferred with the accountant vis-à-vis the proposed budget.
他们与会计商量有关预算提案的事。

accrue
音标：英 /ə'kru:/  美 /ə'kru/
v. 积累
例句：Interest will accrue until payment is made.
利息将会累计增加，直至付清款项。

accurate
音标：英 /ˈækjərət/  美 /'ækjərət/
adj. 精确的
短语：accurate measurement — 精确测量
短语：accurate positioning — 精确定位
短语：accurate model — 准确模型
短语：accurate simulation — 准确模拟
短语：accurate at — 对…很正确
短语：accurate calibration — 精确校准
短语：accurate record — 精确记录
短语：accurate adjustment — 精调；精密调整
短语：accurate grinding — 精磨；精密磨削
例句：The brochure tries to give a fair and accurate description of each hotel.
该手册尽量公正、准确地介绍每一家酒店。

accuse
音标：英 /ə'kju:z/  美 /ə'kjuz/
v. 指控
短语：accuse of — 谴责，控告
例句：The professor stands accused of (=  has been accused of  ) stealing his student’s ideas and publishing them.
那位教授被指控剽窃学生的观点拿去发表。

accustom
音标：英 /ə'kʌstəm/  美 /ə'kʌstəm/
v. 使习惯
例句：She tried to accustom herself to the tight bandages.
她尝试着使自己习惯那些紧绷的绷带。

achieve
音标：英 /ə'tʃi:v/  美 /ə'tʃiv/
v. 达到，实现
短语：achieve success — 取得成功；获得成功
短语：achieve one's goals — 实现目标
例句：Frances achieved very good exam results.
弗朗西丝考试取得了优异成绩。
例句：Wilson has achieved considerable success as an artist.
威尔逊作为一名艺术家成就斐然。
例句：She eventually achieved her goal of becoming a professor.
她终于实现目标，当上了教授。

acquaintance
音标：英 /ə'kweɪntəns/  美 /ə'kwentəns/
n. 熟人
短语：acquaintance with — 相识
短语：acquaintance with someone — 对某人的相识，熟
短语：nodding acquaintance — 相识不深的人；不完整或肤浅的知识
短语：make the acquaintance of — vt. 和…相识，结识
例句：She was a casual acquaintance of my family in Vienna.
她是我们家在维也纳的一个交情不深的朋友。
例句：He heard about the job through a mutual acquaintance (=  someone you and another person both know  ) .
他是通过一个双方都认识的人知道有这份工作的。

activate
音标：英 /'æktɪveɪt/  美 /'æktə'vet/
v. 激活
例句：Cooking fumes may activate the alarm.
烹调时的油烟可能会触发警报器。
例句：The yeast’s growth is activated by sugar and warmth.
糖分和温暖的环境会激发酵母菌的生长。

acutely
音标：英 /əˈkju:tli/  美 /ə'kjutli/
adv. 敏锐地
短语：acutely aware — 清醒地看到
例句：We continue to conduct tests, but increasingly, we conduct long conversations with her, acutely aware that our creation will raise many ethical questions on the part of the public.
我们将继续进行测试，但越来越多地，随着长时间的交谈，我们敏锐地意识到，我们的作品将在公众当中引起许多道德问题。

addict
音标：英 /'ædɪkt/  美 /'ædɪkt (for n.); əˈdɪkt (for v.)/
v. 上瘾，沉溺
短语：drug addict — 吸毒者；滥用药物者
例句：Meanwhile, Walt's meth-business partner, the addict Jesse, is still recovering from the drug-related death of his girlfriend Jane at the end of last season.
而沃特的制毒搭档——瘾君子杰西还未从女朋友之死的痛苦中恢复过来。 他的女朋友简在上一季结尾时死于毒品。

address
音标：英 /ə'dres/  美 /ə'drɛs/
v. 解决
短语：email address — 电子邮箱信箱
短语：ip address — 网络地址，IP地址
短语：address book — 通讯簿；住址名册
短语：home address — 家庭住址；标识地址；内部地址
短语：mailing address — 邮寄地址
短语：network address — 网络地址
短语：address space — 地址空间
短语：address as — 称呼
短语：e-mail address — 电子邮件地址
短语：public address — 公用地址；扩音装置
短语：address system — 地址系统；称谓系统
短语：inaugural address — 就职演说
短语：address translation — 地址转换；位址翻译
短语：public address system — 扩声系统；有线广播系统；公用地址系统
短语：correspondence address — 通讯地址；通信地址
短语：specific address — 专用地址
短语：full address — 全地址
短语：physical address — 物理地址；实际地址
短语：permanent address — 永久地址；永久住址；原籍
短语：mail address — 邮件地址；信件地址

administration
音标：英 /ədˌmɪnɪˈstreɪʃn/  美 /əd,mɪnɪ'streʃən/
n. 管理，政府
短语：administration of — ◎(法律、惩罚等的)施行，执行，实行，实施；(药的)服用；用法；给与；(庄严的誓言或诺言的)提出，宣誓
短语：business administration — 企业管理；经营管理
短语：public administration — 公共行政；公共管理；行政管理
短语：general administration — 总管理处
短语：food and drug administration — 食品和药物管理局
短语：administration department — 行政部
短语：educational administration — 教育管理；教育行政管理
短语：civil administration — n. 民政
短语：tax administration — 税务管理
短语：administration of justice — 司法；司法行政；执法
短语：school administration — 学校行政；学院管理
短语：oral administration — [医]口服
短语：state environmental protection administration — 国家环境保护总局
短语：personnel administration — 干部（人事）管理
短语：administration office — 行政办公室；秘书室
短语：administration fee — 管理费；手续费
短语：financial administration — 财务管理
短语：administration structure — 行政机构
短语：foreign exchange administration — 外汇管理局
短语：administration building — 行政办公楼
例句：We’re looking for someone with experience in administration.
我们正在寻找一个有管理经验的人。
例句：The health service spends too much on administration.
医疗服务部门在行政方面花费太多。

adopt
音标：英 /ə'dɒpt/  美 /ə'dɑpt/
v. 采纳
短语：adopt various methods — 采取不同办法
例句：The courts were asked to adopt a more flexible approach to young offenders.
法庭被要求对少年犯采取更为灵活的处理方法。
例句：The store recently adopted a drug testing policy for all new employees.
这家商店近来实行新雇员一律要做药检的政策。
例句：California has adopted a tough stance on the issue.
加利福尼亚州对这一问题持强硬立场。
